SCE.S:2F854: Works at my office. Mother is from Hong Kong. Good at moving fast.
SCE.S:59008:
...You find yourself thinking: "This place is like the bottom of a deep sea." Little by little, you float up out of the sea of the unconscious.
...You were born in the City. As a child, it was full of life. Then the City suddenly changed, and after high school you left it too.
After university, you became a reporter for a local paper.
...Decades later, you return to the City where you grew up.
...Your mind is clearing.
5 a.m., after a night of work with your young assistant. You will remember this as the day it all began.

SCE.S:59808.text:
The "Catapult of Consciousness" has crumbled, and the road to the other dimension is closed. It all ended like a dream.
....What the changes in the City really meant, you can no longer understand.
..Was the Earth saved? Or perhaps it wasn't.. You can't say for sure.
But deep in your heart...... something has changed, without a doubt.....
....Your mind is clearing. It is 5 a.m., after a night of writing up small, everyday stories.
Before you, the City is back, just as it always was.
SCE.S:59808.note: ending narration: if it is split across scenes like the opening, the split point is unverified

SCE.S:5B128:
Busy with a story?
Is there anything you need?
SCE.S:5B1F8:
You've got mail.
Did you read it properly?
SCE.S:5B280: Mr. Fujita's place? Try asking at the map shop across from our building.
SCE.S:5B328:
Wait a moment.
You've got mail.
SCE.S:5B3B0: Take the blue {7}car{2} parked out front. It's the company's. If you lose track of the {7}car{2} out in the City, call me from the nearest {7}phone booth{2}. I'll bring the {7}car{2} to you, wherever you are.
SCE.S:5B8F8:
Hello... It's Fujita... You?! ...It's been so long!
So you read my mail. Sorry it was so strange. I... just don't know what to do. I know you're busy, but please come to my place right away! Please... It may matter to the whole City.
I'll be waiting!
SCE.S:5BA88: Hello? It's me! Fujita! What are you doing there? Why did you suddenly leave? I'm still at the power plant. Something's wrong here... something! Hurry back! If you can't find it, ask at the map shop.
SCE.S:5BBB4: Hello? Can you hear me? ...Is that you? It's Fujita! I'm at the seaside warehouses! Hurry! I'm waiting!
SCE.S:5BC7C:
Hello.... Hello....
I'm with the Defense Bureau. Your superior should have told you. We need your help. An agent waits at Grand Station... Kouda. He'll wait until you arrive. Follow his orders. Sorry it's so sudden, but help us, for your country. I'm counting on you.
SCE.S:5BE24: Hello? .... ...It's Naomi. ...Remember me? We were in high school together... Yes, me.... Did you read my mail? It's been so long. ...How are you? Your voice hasn't changed. I'm at a hotel near you. If it's all right, I'd like to see you tonight at the hotel. Past the lobby there's a row of sofas. I'll wait there around nine. I can't wait to see you! Tonight, then...
SCE.S:5C034: Hello, it's Naomi. Just got in? Staying at the office? ...That's rough. Don't work too hard. Today was so much fun. ...Thank you, really. I want to see you again soon! Good night....
SCE.S:5C160: Hello? It's Naomi. I'm at the hotel... Can we meet right now? I'll be in the restaurant on the 1st floor. Come quick! ...Please!
SCE.S:5C24C: It's me! Naomi! I'm at the hospital! I need help! There are more victims by the minute. Some doctors sealed off the back wards and it's chaos! They've all gone mad! Hurry! ...Help me!
SCE.S:5C360: Hello? ...Is this the newspaper? This is New Town Public Hospital. We've tried the police and fire department, but we can't get through! Please help us!! It's hard to explain, but Wards 2 and 3 are sealed off! ..It's out of control! People have died. Please hurry!
SCE.S:5C4DC: Hello? Is this the newspaper? I'm from the congregation of the great cathedral in the Old Town... I mailed you before. The priests have even taken up arms. Something has holed up in the bell tower. Can you come help now?
SCE.S:5C608: Hello? Do you know who I am? No, I suppose not. ...I've heard a lot about you, from your friend Fujita. ...I'm a kindred spirit of his, you might say. Only a handful know what's happening to this City. I want to give you something. Used well, it may save the City. ...The people here are an ordinary lot, but if this isn't stopped here, the whole Earth will be transformed. Whether that's good or bad, honestly, I can't say. But I'm rather fond of the Earth as it is. I want you to stop the "change"! I live between the Old Town and Central. Come to my place! It's a bit famous: crop circles keep appearing around it. Come by any time.
SCE.S:5C944:
Hello? Remember me? Hurry to the crop-circle house. I have something else for you. I'm counting on you.
....Unnatural evolution builds up distortions of energy. The City is storing up a huge one. We must act before the bill comes due. Come right away.
SCE.S:5CAF0: Hello, the newspaper? What's happening to the City? Nothing in this morning's local edition. Every road out of town is cut off! That's no accident! We want the truth! What are you hiding?! What's going on?!
SCE.S:5CC28: Hello. I am your anonymous friend. I wish to help you. ...However, I don't approve of reckless violence. Take care not to harm anyone else unconnected to the "incident"!
SCE.S:5CD40: Hello. I am your anonymous friend. Your work has been noted. But we'd rather you didn't drag more ordinary citizens into this. If you do, we can no longer extend you our special, extralegal protection. Act with care.
SCE.S:5CE94: Hello, the newspaper? This is New Town Public Hospital. We've found a way to stop the bodily changes. Please announce it widely: anyone whose family or friends seem abnormal should come to the hospital at once. If the change isn't too advanced, we can return them to normal. Print it: "Come to the hospital, quickly!" Please!
SCE.S:5D8A8: Welcome back. It's terrible! The police called for you. Please go to the police station right away.
